headline: Maximum fuel prices will rise over the weekend and on Monday | ČeskéNoviny.cz
summary: Maximum diesel prices will rise to 47.67 crowns per litre and petrol to 46.48 crowns, the Finance Ministry decided. The petrol cap is the highest since price regulation began.
why: Czech fuel price caps set by the Finance Ministry directly determine retail fuel prices, which affect transport costs and inflation.
